title: Provide portable offline architecture reading
statement: The Views and traceability Module shall provide portable offline architecture reading within its accountable browser contribution to SR-086, retaining the stated limits of collaborating owners.

what.problem: A locally successful browser step can hide missing ownership or an invalid cross-boundary conclusion.

why.rationale: MOD-004 owns the behavior necessary for the selected SR-086 criteria; the SR remains the system-wide obligation.

conditions: When generating, reading, recovering or qualifying the selected browser scope.

contexts: MOD-004 and its declared browser cooperation contracts.

how.approach: Apply the constrained Functions and preserve source, output, qualification and authority distinctions at the boundary.

how_much.scope: Contribution to SR-086 criteria 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. Other Module contributions and final product qualification remain distinct.

acceptance_criteria: Copy the complete output to another supported reading environment, make the source checkout unavailable and disable network access; required navigation, diagrams, definitions and included rationale remain usable.
The snapshot contains the reading resources and source detail needed to understand its selected scope; unavailable optional external links do not replace required explanations.
Reading requires no generator, rendering compiler, remote fonts or script CDN, hosted service or local operational database.
The reader can identify project/profile, input content identity and generator provenance; the snapshot does not claim live freshness without a fresh comparison.
Opening or copying the snapshot does not alter engineering sources or grant permission to publish customer information.
constraints: Draft allocation; does not establish implemented browser support or requirement satisfaction.

sources.basis: System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.
